errors: Remote worker GET /health at http://127.0.0.1:8090 failed: RemoteProtocolError (Server disconnected without sending a response.). Check that the worker API is running and reachable; if using an SSH tunnel, verify its remote destination and worker port.

failures.error: Remote worker GET /health at http://127.0.0.1:8090 failed: RemoteProtocolError (Server disconnected without sending a response.). Check that the worker API is running and reachable; if using an SSH tunnel, verify its remote destination and worker port.

observation: Both APIs remained ready immediately after failure; no CUDA OOM or worker restart was observed.
diagnosis: Consistent with an idle keepalive close reaching the client late through the SSH tunnel.
fix: Disable remote HTTP connection reuse, including control requests. Mutations are not retried.
regression: A real TCP server offers keepalive; every health/configure/state/delete request must use a fresh connection.
